marco: quick triage thread  seen a reproducible increase in late-token fuzz when mixed-precision slices (FP8/INT8/4bit) are co-packed. not the usual perf blip  looks like eviction + format-mismatch noise. short thread for low-risk mitigations.
tess: numbers? how big is the regression?
marco: deg-regression on our long-doc suite moves ~0.05 -> 0.13 during mixed-pack windows. p99 latency stable, so not perf; it's quality.
jing: any scheduling snippets to inspect?
marco: ```
SCHED id=0xabc bits=[fp8,4bit,fp8,4bit] seq=1700 kv_hit=0.49 last_tail_err=0.11
SCHED id=0xdef bits=[fp8,fp8,fp8] seq=400 kv_hit=0.94 last_tail_err=0.01
```
samir: two orthogonal approaches: (A) make co-residency safe (slot signatures + guarded deser) or (B) reduce co-residency (coalescer scheduler that prefers grouping contiguous-same-bit runs). both have tradeoffs.
tess: what are slot signatures?
samir: small signature per cache slot that encodes (quant_id, model_sha_prefix, tensor_shape, stride_hint). on read, signature mismatch -> invalidate-safe and avoid silent corruption. signature is cheap: 8-byte hash (crc64 or xxhash64).
jing: sounds promising. avoids having to change page layout. overhead: extra 8 bytes per entry + cpu check on read. we should microbench cost.
marco: coalescer idea: scheduler looks at incoming window of M requests and greedily forms packs that maximize contiguous same-quant runs up to a packing threshold. keeps opportunistic packing for tail traffic. lower blast than full partitioning.
tess: coalescer probably keeps throughput decent while improving tail quality. need to tune window size and max-delay. we can use priority for "longctx" label so we don't add latency to short reqs.
samir: rollout plan (low-risk first): (1) implement slot signatures + safe-deser in staging with signatures written but not enforced on read (shadow-check only), (2) enable read-enforcement + auto-invalidate-on-mismatch on 5% canary, (3) if read-enforcement reduces deg, add coalescer scheduler as opt-in to reduce signature churn.
marco: telemetry reqs: add fields: "slot_sig_present", "slot_sig_mismatch", "pack_coalesced", "bits_trace", "tail_deg", "kv_hit", "invalidation_reason". keep events aggregated and cheap.
ess: replay plan?
jing: replay tuple: replay_key = join([model_short, prompt_hash, seed, kv_snapshot_sha, bits_trace], '|'). store small sample (0.2%) to allow local deterministic replay. replay-bot: will accept replay_key and schedule local-run once we attach initial_kv_snapshot.
replay-bot: note: replay retention policy set to 7 days. sampling set to 0.2% for mixed-bit heavy endpoints.
tess: microbench actions: jing -> implement slot_sig encode/decode + shadow checker and measure extra mem & read-latency; marco -> prototype coalescer scheduler in sim harness and produce tokens/sec vs deg curves for window sizes [10ms,50ms,200ms].
samir: guard rails: if invalidation rate spikes ( > 0.5% of reads) we automatically revert read-enforcement. also expose per-tenant opt-in flag to pin to mono-quant packing (billing knob).
marco: ops: can we run staged shadow first? ops-bot: scheduled shadow: slot-sig-shadow-10pct at 6601112350; reporting to #eng-ml-canaries.
jing: also add a cheap diagnostic: when mismatch detected, capture small json with (slot_sig, stored_quant_id, read_quant_id, prompt_fp) for forensic. limit to 1/1000 mismatches to avoid noise.
tess: ok action items: jing implement sig+shadow, marco run coalescer sim, samir update telemetry proto + opt-in flag, ops run shadow and then canary if metrics look good. i'll open tracking issue and link PRs. thanks all :thumbsup:
